extDesc.message: AI bilingual captions for X (Twitter) videos. The original line always stays visible. Bring your own ASR/LLM keys — open source, no subscription.

toast_gif.message: This is an animated GIF — no audio to transcribe.

toast_need_play.message: Start playing the video once, then click CC again.

toast_no_media.message: Could not locate this video's stream. Play the video and retry.

toast_no_asr_key.message: No ASR key configured. Open Settings to add one.

toast_no_llm_key.message: No translation key configured. Open Settings to add one.

toast_ready.message: Captions ready — they appear on the video as it plays. Press play.

toast_translation_partial.message: Some lines could not be translated; original is shown.

err_asr_auth.message: ASR provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.

err_asr_failed.message: Transcription failed. Try again in a moment.

err_llm_auth.message: Translation provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.

err_llm_failed.message: Translation failed. Try again in a moment.

err_audio_fetch.message: Could not download the video's audio stream.

err_no_speech.message: No speech detected in this video.

popup_keys_missing.message: API keys missing — captions will not work yet.

popup_ready.message: Ready. Click the CC button on any X video.

opt_custom_terms_ph.message: Names/jargon to recognize, e.g. ProductName, PersonName (comma or newline separated)

opt_keys_note.message: Keys are stored only in this browser (chrome.storage.local) and sent only to the provider you choose. They never touch Acousmos servers.
